name: Node Comics MTU CUDA - online source
onstart:
set +x
umask 077
bash -e <<'NODE_COMICS_BOOTSTRAP'
if ! printf 'REPLACE_WITH_BOOTSTRAP_SHA256  /opt/node-comics-bootstrap.py\n' | sha256sum --status -c -; then
  bootstrap_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/node-comics-bootstrap.XXXXXX)
  trap 'rm -f -- "$bootstrap_tmp"' EXIT
  curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 5 --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 120 -o "$bootstrap_tmp" REPLACE_WITH_VERSIONED_BOOTSTRAP_URL
  printf 'REPLACE_WITH_BOOTSTRAP_SHA256  %s\n' "$bootstrap_tmp" | sha256sum -c -
  install -m 700 "$bootstrap_tmp" /opt/node-comics-bootstrap.py
  rm -f -- "$bootstrap_tmp"
  trap - EXIT
fi
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/node-comics-bootstrap.py --revision REPLACE_WITH_SOURCE_COMMIT
NODE_COMICS_BOOTSTRAP
node_bootstrap_status=$?
unset NODE_CONTROL_URL NODE_ID NODE_TOKEN NODE_RESOURCE_ID
if [ "$node_bootstrap_status" -ne 0 ]; then printf 'Node bootstrap failed (exit %s); inspect instance logs and retry after resolving the reported stage.\n' "$node_bootstrap_status"; fi
exec entrypoint.sh --no-update-portal --no-update-vast
desc: Source template: pin a published commit and bootstrap checksum; dependencies and assets download on the server.
readme: Use the supplied SSH on-start script. Give every instance its own NODE_ID, NODE_TOKEN and NODE_RESOURCE_ID. The server pulls pinned source, installs locked Python dependencies, downloads verified models/fonts, and reuses the Vast CUDA/driver environment. No environment export or upload. Cache is reused after interruption. Supervisor starts and recovers the node. Drain before explicit upgrades or rollbacks; keep /var/lib/node-comics on persistent storage. Preserve the Vast platform entrypoint and normal outbound network.
